x: Len Herbert and Tom Carter finished together in the third place in 32m. 46s., and in true Belgrave spirit Tom waived any claim to the 3rd medal and it was handed to Len who had not previously won a Southern medal. Other positions were 14th, Hoath, 33.44; 15, Tobin, 33.48; 21, Green, 33.59; 23, Speaight, 34.1; 26, S.
